<slate title="Branch">
  <column id="root">
    <empty
      id="none"
      title="Not a checkout"
      body="This thread's folder is not a git checkout."
      when={git.branch == null}
    />
    <row id="head" between when={git.branch != null}>
      <text id="branch" mono strong>{git.branch}</text>
      <text id="read" muted small when={exists(git.readAt)}>read {ago(git.readAt)}</text>
    </row>
    <facts id="counts" grid when={git.branch != null}>
      <fact
        label="Ahead"
        value={git.countsUnknown ? 'unknown' : plural(git.ahead, 'commit')}
        tone={git.countsUnknown ? 'muted' : 'default'}
      />
      <fact
        label="Behind"
        value={git.countsUnknown ? 'unknown' : plural(git.behind, 'commit')}
        tone={git.countsUnknown ? 'muted' : (git.behind > 0 ? 'warning' : 'default')}
      />
      <fact label="Changed" value={plural(git.changed, 'file')} />
    </facts>
    <button
      id="rebase"
      primary
      label="Rebase onto upstream"
      note={`${plural(git.behind, 'commit')} behind`}
      when={git.branch != null and not git.countsUnknown and git.behind > 0}
      onPress={send("The branch is behind upstream. Rebase it onto upstream and resolve any conflicts.", { with: [git.branch, git.ahead, git.behind, git.changed] })}
    />
  </column>
</slate>
